title: Some Methods to Solve the Diophantine Equation ay^2=b(x^k-c^k)
summary: The solution of the Diophantine equation ay^2=b(x^k-c^k) is studied in different cases of k. Methods are proposed for different cases of k, which are convenient for computer algorithm implementation. The original equation is reduced to lower-degree equations, which can improve the efficiency in searching possible integer solutions. A sufficient condition of the unsolvability of ay^2=b(x^2n-c^2n) is presented.
